scope: Conservative evidence-backed production-readiness assessment, separate from canonical task acceptance.
rounding: Round the final total to nearest integer; show category scores and evidence.

criteria.name: Nine requested synthetic API end-to-end stages
criteria.rule: 14 * number of independently working stages / 9; mark offline CRM proposal as partial, not a completed external CRM integration.

criteria.name: 170 route functional verification
criteria.rule: 6 * independently working route definitions / actual total; policy-blocked and incomplete positive functionality earn no functional points.

scoringRules: Every awarded point must cite exact evidence and candidate product hashes.
Partial credit must state the tested fraction or concrete subset; do not award for route existence alone.
Unknown, missing, blocked positive operation or unexecuted validation earns zero for that criterion.
A high numerical assessment never bypasses hard gates.
Canonical acceptance JSON/validator absence prevents formal 52-task acceptance; it does not justify inventing a score or pass.
